title.heading: JOHN 10 & 17
title.sub: I and the Father Are One

units.tts: Jesus answered,
subs: Jesus answered,

units.tts: I did tell you, but you do not believe.
subs: “I did tell you,|but you do not believe.

units.tts: The works I do in my Father's name testify about me,
subs: The works I do in my|Father’s name testify about me,

units.tts: but you do not believe because you are not my sheep.
subs: but you do not believe because|you are not my sheep.

units.tts: My sheep listen to my voice;
subs: My sheep listen to my voice;

units.tts: I know them, and they follow me.
subs: I know them,|and they follow me.

units.tts: I give them eternal life, and they shall never perish;
subs: I give them eternal life,|and they shall never perish;

units.tts: no one will snatch them out of my hand.
subs: no one will snatch them|out of my hand.

units.tts: My Father, who has given them to me, is greater than all;
subs: My Father, who has given them|to me, is greater than all;

units.tts: no one can snatch them out of my Father's hand.
subs: no one can snatch them|out of my Father’s hand.

units.tts: I and the Father are one.
subs: I and the Father|are one.”

units.tts: Again his Pharisee opponents picked up stones to stone him,
subs: Again his Pharisee opponents|picked up stones to stone him,

units.tts: but Jesus said to them,
subs: but Jesus said to them,

units.tts: I have shown you many good works from the Father.
subs: “I have shown you many|good works from the Father.

units.tts: For which of these do you stone me?
subs: For which of these|do you stone me?”

units.tts: We are not stoning you for any good work, they replied,
subs: “We are not stoning you for|any good work,” they replied,

units.tts: but for blasphemy, because you, a mere man, claim to be God.
subs: “but for blasphemy,
because you, a mere man,|claim to be God.”

units.tts: Jesus answered them,
subs: Jesus answered them,

units.tts: Is it not written in your Law, I have said you are gods?
subs: “Is it not written in your Law,
‘I have said you are “gods” ’?

units.tts: If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came,
subs: If he called them ‘gods,’|to whom the word of God came—

units.tts: and Scripture cannot be set aside,
subs: and Scripture cannot be set aside—

units.tts: what about the one whom the Father set apart as his very own and sent into the world?
subs: what about the one whom the|Father set apart as his very own
and sent into the world?

units.tts: Why then do you accuse me of blasphemy because I said, I am God's Son?
subs: Why then do you accuse me|of blasphemy because I said,
‘I am God’s Son’?

units.tts: Do not believe me unless I do the works of my Father.
subs: Do not believe me unless|I do the works of my Father.

units.tts: But if I do them, even though you do not believe me, believe the works,
subs: But if I do them, even though|you do not believe me,
believe the works,

units.tts: that you may know and understand that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.
subs: that you may know and understand
that the Father is in me,|and I in the Father.”

units.tts: Again they tried to seize him, but he escaped their grasp.
subs: Again they tried to seize him,
but he escaped their grasp.

units.tts: My prayer is not for them alone.
subs: My prayer is not for them alone.

units.tts: I pray also for those who will believe in me through their message,
subs: I pray also for those|who will believe in me
through their message,

units.tts: that all of them may be one, Father, just as you are in me and I am in you.
subs: that all of them may be one, Father,
just as you are in me|and I am in you.

units.tts: May they also be in us so that the world may believe that you have sent me.
subs: May they also be in us
so that the world may believe|that you have sent me.

units.tts: I have given them the glory that you gave me, that they may be one as we are one,
subs: I have given them the glory|that you gave me,
that they may be one|as we are one—

units.tts: I in them and you in me, so that they may be brought to complete unity.
subs: I in them and you in me—
so that they may be brought|to complete unity.

units.tts: Then the world will know that you sent me and have loved them as you have loved me.
subs: Then the world will know|that you sent me
and have loved them|as you have loved me.

units.tts: Father, I want those you have given me to be with me where I am,
subs: Father, I want those|you have given me
to be with me where I am,

units.tts: and to see my glory, the glory you have given me because you loved me before the creation of the world.
subs: and to see my glory,
the glory you have given me
because you loved me before|the creation of the world.

units.tts: Righteous Father, though the world does not know you, I know you, and they know that you have sent me.
subs: Righteous Father, though the|world does not know you,
I know you, and they know|that you have sent me.

units.tts: I have made you known to them, and will continue to make you known,
subs: I have made you known to them,
and will continue|to make you known

units.tts: in order that the love you have for me may be in them,
subs: in order that the love you have|for me may be in them

units.tts: and that I myself may be in them.
subs: and that I myself|may be in them.
